d:
Relive the fun and romance of “Le Pappiyan Jhappiyan” from Haqeeqat, featuring the melodious voices of Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik, with lyrics by Gulshan Bawra and music composed by Dilip Sen - Sameer Sen.
Song Details:
Song Name: Le Pappiyan Jhappiyan
Singer: Kumar Sanu, Alka Yagnik
Lyricist: Gulshan Bawra
Music Composer: Dilip Sen - Sameer Sen
Movie Details:
Movie Name: Haqeeqat
